prompt: Should your brand feel affordable, premium or luxury?
because: This sets your prices, your packaging and how your logo should look.
helpPrompt: If a customer saw your price next to a supermarket's, should yours look cheaper, about the same, or clearly better?

options.label: Affordable
options.hint: Best price wins. Simple, honest, everyday.

options.label: Accessible premium
options.hint: Feels special, priced so ordinary people can still buy it.

options.label: Premium
options.hint: Quality first. Customers pay more, and know why.

options.label: Luxury
options.hint: Rare, crafted, exclusive. Price is not the point.

options.label: Contemporary
options.hint: Current and design-led. Follows what people want now.

options.label: Mass market
options.hint: Made for volume. Familiar and easy to reach.
